# FDG3063

> DO NOT use “Flag” or “Flags” suffixes in enum type names.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.3 Naming Enumerations.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1711
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, the following enum is badly named:

```csharp
// Bad naming
[Flags]
public enum ColorFlags {
  ...
}
```
